lines.name: Gigabyte Server System G294-S41-AAP2

items.spec:
Gigabyte Server System G294-S41-AAP2

- Dual Intel® Xeon® 6700/6500-Series Processors
  Dual processor, TDP up to 250W
- System on Chip
- 8-Channel DDR5 RDIMM / MRDIMM, 24 x DIMMs
  Dual ROM Architecture
- 2 x 10Gb/s LAN ports via Intel® X710-AT2
  8 x 2.5" Gen5 NVMe/SATA/SAS-4 hot-swap bays
- 4 x FHFL PCIe Gen5 x16 or 8 x FHFL PCIe Gen5 x8 slots for GPUs
- 2 x LP PCIe Gen5 x16 slots
- Aspeed® AST2600 management controller
- 1x MegaRaid 9500 series
- Dual 3000W 80 PLUS Titanium redundant power supply
NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

notes:
* ADVANTECH 정품공급확약서 및 기술지원확약서 필수 제출
* XD00035590-01 GPU 파워케이블 필수 공급 (GPU Cable)
